evidence: Estimates and PESA publish it every year; no OSCAR extract or in-year release carries it (docs/profiling/plan-sources.md section 12)

sr_group_name: Combined pre-2023: BEIS, DCMS and DIT
description: The three departments as they stood before the February 2023 reorganisation, kept as one group because the published plans cannot be split onto the new departments.
evidence: docs/profiling/plan-sources.md sections 12 and 13: no PESA edition and no Estimates workbook gives FY2022-23 plans on the new structure
note: Only the Estimates and PESA lines for the three pre-2023 departments, and the OSCAR plan rows of the same departments, map here.

description: Central reserve lines inside the DEL tables, including the part published as retained-budget-exchange-excluded.
evidence: PESA and SR25 department-group sections carry Reserves as a line that is in the table total
note: Includes the retained-budget-exchange split of the reserve where PESA 2024 prints it as a component; that component is never added again.

description: The Office for Budget Responsibility allowance for departmental underspend, a negative line in the DEL totals.
evidence: PESA Table 1.3 and its successors
note: A negative line, so the groups plus this line add to the published DEL total.

description: The adjustment for Budget Exchange carried as a line inside the DEL totals.
evidence: PESA Table 1.3 and its successors; Estimates 2026-27 Mains total reconciles to PESA 2026 only after this adjustment
note: A negative line in the years where PESA prints it.

description: Funds not yet allocated to a department (Levelling Up Fund, UK Shared Prosperity Fund, Growth Mission Fund, Transformation Fund, IFRS16 provisions and similar).
evidence: PESA and SR25 department-group sections carry these as separate lines inside the totals
note: Several published lines share this member; they are added together in dw.fact_plan.

description: Lines that are not budgets of a group: accounting adjustments, the Scottish block grant adjustment line, debt interest, memo items.
evidence: PESA Table 1.3 (2026) puts the Scottish Government Block Grant Adjustments line after the total
note: Component lines of this member (the block grant adjustment line, ratios, memo rows) are never added into a total.

sr_group_name: Central exchequer and local government lines
description: Non-budget and non-departmental AME lines OSCAR carries without a Spending Review group: the central exchequer, housing revenue accounts and London Underground.
evidence: OSCAR annual extracts, plan rows with SR_GROUP_CODE n/a (organisations CEX086, LEX086, PEX086, EHR101, ELU101, SHR103, WHR104)
note: OSCAR's own label for these organisations is a Spending Review group of n/a.

description: Outturn lines of a closed or split department that no current department took over (the BEIS shared lines, the Electoral Commission, the Assets Recovery Agency, the Department for Exiting the European Union). No plan is published for them.
evidence: stg.current_structure_map: the current department of the line is an Unallocated member of dw.dim_department (U084, U011, U077, U035); 36 organisation version and sub-segment pairs, docs/data-dictionary/plan-phasing.md
note: Outturn only, so it has no plan rows. I keep it apart from Unallocated central funds, which is where the plans put funds not yet allocated to a department, so that a plan row of that member is never phased on the outturn of an unrelated closed department.
